conversion: Assisted-sale qualification; delivery default OFF with environment-owned activation; live host activation NOT DONE

lead_delivery.default_state: OFF — safe non-live mode (no mail, no persistence, no logging)
lead_delivery.activation: DUAL GATE — environment-owned wp-config constant CPMS_LEAD_DELIVERY_ENABLED (boolean true; theme never defines it) AND the administrator site-level switch in Koorosh Theme Settings (default OFF)
lead_delivery.transport: WordPress-native wp_mail only; SMTP/deliverability configuration is environment-owned and outside Git
lead_delivery.persistence: none — submissions are never stored in the WordPress database or logs
lead_delivery.inbox_delivery: NOT VERIFIED — wp_mail acceptance proves mail-layer handoff only
lead_delivery.live_host_activation: NOT DONE — requires an explicit environment decision plus real host acceptance
